<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par139 />{{GHGmargin-letter|139|g}}
3. {{GHGheb|text=עֶ֫צֶם|translate=bone}} (then metaphorically for ''substance'') expresses the idea of ''self, selfsame, very same'', in reference to ''things'' (as {{GHGheb|text=נֶ֫פֶשׁ}} to persons, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=בְּעֶ֫צֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה|translate=in the selfsame day}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=7|verse=13}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=10|verse=27}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=24|verse=2}}; {{GHGheb|text=כְּעֶ֫צֶם הַשָּׁמַ֫יִם לָטֹהַר|translate=as it were the very heaven for clearness}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=24|verse=10}}; {{GHGheb|text=בְּעֶ֫צֶם תֻּמּוֹ|translate=in the very fullness of his strength}} (= ''in the midst of his full strength''), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=21|verse=23}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|139|h}}
4. The simple plural of words denoting time sometimes includes also the idea of a ''few, some'';<ref>''Some'' in reference to persons in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=16|verse=20}} is expressed by {{GHGheb|text=אֲנָשִׁים}}, and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=5|verse=2}}–4 by {{GHGheb|text=יֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר|translate=sunt qui}}, with a participle following.</ref> thus {{GHGheb|text=יָמִים|translate=a few days}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=24|verse=55}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=40|verse=4|hidebook=1}} (here even of a longer period, = ''for some time''); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=65|verse=20}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=8|verse=27}} (on the other hand, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=44}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=29|verse=20|hidebook=1}} {{GHGheb|text=יָמִים אֲחָדִים}}; see § 96 under {{GHGheb|text=אֶחָד}}); {{GHGheb|text=שָׁנִים|translate=some years}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=11|verse=6}}, 8.<section end=par139 /><noinclude>
<references/></noinclude>
